evidence: Both reports by K. V. Kumar match on participant stature and weight, the Bruce treadmill test and 45-minute equilibration at 15,000 ft, the leaking airlock and brief descent to about 6,000 ft, resumed exercise, left-elbow pain after descent, the unavailable hyperbaric chamber and the 65% and 50% packed-cell-volume measurements. The age, symptom timing and recovery wording differ. The 1988 paper identifies the site as the Institute of Aviation Medicine, Bangalore, India.
